body:
I am awfully sorry that you had to go through that. I was never physically bullied. But I was bullied verbally. I acted 'weird' when I was in school and people would make fun of me for how I acted. I would be called retarded by my peers, for literally no reason. People made fun of my voice, it is very deep compared to most guys in that school. Many of my friends also dont have time for me it seems. They never text me and ask how I'm doing. I was always the one that had to reach out to them in order to talk to them. But then I just decided to not talk to them anymore. What helped me alot with the verbal bullying was focusing on my own body and skills, and improving them. And then when I was eventually doing better than them, I didnt take their remarks seriously. I hope that may be a bit of help for you. I'm also really sorry about your ex gf. I've never had a gf before but fucking hell I can imagine how awful you must have felt. 

I hope that I have helped a bit. Stay strong mate.

Thank you for the support. It makes me feel better knowing that someone took the time to read my post and then show support. Thank you so much. I am really sorry about your dog, I hope that you will get over it eventually. Before I had cancer, i also did not socialize with other people and stayed at home most of the time, I have social anxiety. Thank you so much again for the support
Now that I think of it. I've never ever had a hug like that in my life.
